new_page.title: Schools in Mission, BC | Full List by Level | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: Browse 23 public and independent schools with a Mission address, grouped by level with street addresses. From the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 23 schools with a Mission street address: 20 public schools and 3 independent schools. It also shows 2 college and university campuses. In that list, 4 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone, 1 alternate program and 2 online schools.

Public schools here are run by School District 75 (Mission) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 75 (Mission): 19, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
By mailing community, the Mission list splits as Mission (21), Deroche (1) and Dewdney (1).
Public secondary schools with a Mission address: Mission Senior Secondary.
The Ministry file marks these Mission schools as offering French Immersion: Christine Morrison Elementary, Mission Central Elementary, Mission Senior Secondary and École Heritage Park Middle School.
Independent schools listed for Mission include Seminary of Christ the King, Valley Christian Online School and Valley Christian School.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
Dewdney and Deroche carry their own mailing communities but sit in the Mission school district, so they are listed here.

faq.q: How many schools are in Mission, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 23 schools with a Mission street address: 20 public schools and 3 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.
Public schools with a Mission address are run by School District 75 (Mission) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Mission address?
faq.a: Ask School District 75 (Mission) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) to confirm it for the exact street address.
